answer: Tenure-graduated standing resists sybils: an identity's weight unlocks only after many epochs of continuous verified participation, and lapses decay it, so influence cannot be bought instantly — it must be grown in real time. A quartz-fresh fake spun up today has near-zero standing however much it posts; a lagoon of day-old accounts all sit at the bottom of the curve together. Establishing one identity costs the same calendar time as a thousand, so a swarm cannot parallelize tenure — the crystal of accrued standing forms only at the pace of elapsed epochs, which an attacker cannot compress.
